name: Alpha-Like Weapons
teaser: Mod that adding standalone versions of weapons look like in alpha build of EFT.
description_html:
Description:

Hello, fellas. This modification is the first that i publishing here, and i want get feedback to understand - the idea sucks or good. My opinion - alpha versions of weapons such as AK74, M4A1, VAL, VSS and other looked better and cooler, more clean and beautiful.

About mod - Adds weapons that look like the ones of the same name from the alpha, but have the same parameters as the weapons today (on the current version of SPT-AKI), and all new features such as overheating, jamming, misfires and other malfunctions. And fully compatible with weapons modules. Yeah, i thought that older models same by topology, but not. And the work was hard, but the result was pleasant.

I advise you to read the documentation, there is information about all ready-made items, plans and credits.

Needed for work

MFAC Shop Module

Installation:
Drop the R41-Alpha-LikeWeapons into your “SPT/user/mods”.
